messages:
claire: Quick note from NovaLyric renewal healthcheck : p95 slipped from ~110ms -> ~240ms during their APAC morning window, CS flagged renewal concern if we don’t present a mitigation plan :worried:
hiro: Any traces? Is it compute, queueing, or cross-region ingress?
amelia: Mix: cross-region hops (traffic hitting us-central) + KV cache churn on long chat sessions. They run a 28B fp16 model with no quant.
claire: Customer wants cost + stability. I'm proposing a short pilot for "dynamic quant": serve a per-request quantized path (layer-wise int8 where safe) for priority intents and a mid-size 12B fallback for session bursts. Also add geo-aware sticky routing to keep APAC sessions on eu/ap-sg nodes to avoid cross-region hops.
hiro: Dynamic quant sounds promising. Ops notes: need hot-swap support for qparams and a preflight to validate layer-wise swap doesn't change top-k behavior much. Route policy: priority_tag -> dedicated-apac pool (quantized), else -> hosted-12b-fallback in-region. If queue_depth>7 -> increase fallback fraction.
amelia: I'll run a regen-quality microbench on their intent set and a layer-sensitivity sweep. We should capture per-layer activation drift and a small attenuation fix if attention norms drift. Also measure token-cost delta (expect ~30-45% on quant paths) and latency impact (+10-25ms compute but fewer queue waits).
claire: Can you sketch the pilot config for CS deck? Keep it minimal: 2% priority traffic to quant path, 5% to 12B fallback, 48h window, automated rollback on quality flags.
amelia: Draft snippet:
```json
{"pilot":{"priority_percent":2,"fallback_percent":5,"window_hours":48},"routes":[{"name":"novalyric-28b-layerwise-int8","route":"dedicated-apac"},{"name":"novalyric-12b-mid","route":"hosted-apac-fallback"}],"slo":{"per_route_timeout_ms":2200,"failover_on_retry":true}}
```
hiro: Ops checklist: enable geo-sticky sessions, pre-warm KV caches on dedicated pool, enable per-route metrics for layer-drift and regen-score, set alert: regen-f1 drop >1.75pts OR user-flag rate >0.8% for 30m. Also expose cost delta to CS.
claire: Great. We'll put this in the renewal pack and propose a short 60-min handoff with NovaLyric next Wed. ops-bot: create ticket CS-12007 and attach ML-EVAL-12007.
ops-bot: Reminder created CS-12007 (novalyric-dynamic-quant-pilot) and linked ML-EVAL-12007.
claire: Thanks team  tagging @hiro @amelia. Amelia, can you post the eval artifacts + quick A/B script by EOD? We'll propose pilot window Thu 9-11am APAC local. This should give NovaLyric a measurable path to lower unit cost and stabilize p95 before renewal. :pray:
